lessons.title: 一般现在时
lessons.summary: 表示经常发生的行为、客观事实、习惯或当前状态。
lessons.structure: be：am / is / are；实义动词肯定：原形 / 第三人称单数形式；否定：don’t / doesn’t + 原形；疑问：Do / Does + 主语 + 原形

forms.label: 肯定句
forms.example: She studies English every day. / He is busy.

forms.label: 否定句
forms.example: She does not study English every day. / He is not busy.

forms.label: 疑问句
forms.example: Does she study English every day? / Is he busy?

usages.label: 习惯或规律
usages.example: I walk to school on weekdays.
usages.translation: 我工作日走路上学。

usages.label: 客观事实与状态
usages.example: Water freezes at 0°C under normal pressure.
usages.translation: 标准气压下，水在0摄氏度结冰。

usages.label: 固定时刻表上的未来
usages.example: The train leaves at 7:30 tomorrow morning.
usages.translation: 列车明早7:30发车。

lessons.judgement: 表示规律、习惯、身份、长期状态或客观事实时，通常采用一般现在时。
lessons.clues: often, usually, every day, on Sundays 等仅是线索；没有这些词，也可以用一般现在时。
pitfalls: 一般现在 vs 现在进行：He works at a library.（工作地点、长期状态）/ He is working at the library today.（今天临时在那儿工作）
三单和助动词：He does not likes → He does not like；does 后接动词原形。
状态动词：I know the answer. 通常不说 I am knowing the answer。

lessons.title: 一般过去时
lessons.summary: 表示过去某一时间发生的动作或存在的状态。
lessons.structure: be：was / were；实义动词肯定：过去式；否定 / 疑问：did + 动词原形

forms.label: 肯定句
forms.example: They watched a film yesterday. / She was tired.

forms.label: 否定句
forms.example: They did not watch a film yesterday. / She was not tired.

forms.label: 疑问句
forms.example: Did they watch a film yesterday? / Was she tired?

usages.label: 明确的过去事件
usages.example: We visited the museum last Sunday.
usages.translation: 我们上周日参观了博物馆。

usages.label: 过去连续发生的动作
usages.example: She opened the door, smiled and walked in.
usages.translation: 她开门、微笑，然后走了进来。

usages.label: 过去某段时期的状态
usages.example: He lived in Beijing when he was young.
usages.translation: 他年轻时住在北京。

lessons.judgement: 明确叙述已经结束的过去事件或状态时，通常采用一般过去时。
lessons.clues: yesterday, last year, two days ago, in 2020（按已过去年份理解）等；判断时应依据语境中的过去参照点。
pitfalls: 过去式 vs 过去分词：wrote 是 write 的过去式，written 是过去分词。
did 后用原形：Did he went? → Did he go?
一般过去 vs 现在完成：I lost my keys yesterday. 强调昨天；I have lost my keys. 强调现在钥匙不见了。

lessons.title: 一般将来时
lessons.english: Future with will / be going to
lessons.summary: 表示将来的决定、意愿、计划或有依据的预测。
lessons.structure: will + 动词原形；am / is / are going to + 动词原形

forms.label: 肯定句
forms.example: They will arrive tomorrow. / She is going to call tonight.

forms.label: 否定句
forms.example: They will not arrive tomorrow. / She is not going to call tonight.

forms.label: 疑问句
forms.example: Will they arrive tomorrow? / Is she going to call tonight?

usages.label: 临时决定
usages.example: The phone is ringing. I will answer it.
usages.translation: 电话响了，我来接。

usages.label: 有依据的预测
usages.example: Look at those clouds. It is going to rain.
usages.translation: 看那些乌云，眼看要下雨了。

usages.label: 原先的打算
usages.example: We are going to visit our grandparents this weekend.
usages.translation: 我们计划本周末看望祖父母。

lessons.judgement: 先确定将来时间，再根据语境区分承诺、临时决定、计划与预测；will和be going to有时可互换。
lessons.clues: tomorrow, next week, soon, in two days 等。提醒：when / if 引导的时间、条件状语从句常用一般现在时代替一般将来时。
pitfalls: 主将从现：I will call you when I get home.（不是 when I will get）
形容词中的 be：She will be ready. be 不能省略。
现在进行时表安排：We are meeting the teacher at 3 p.m. tomorrow. 强调已经安排好的会面。

lessons.title: 现在进行时
lessons.summary: 表示说话时或现阶段正在进行的动作，也可表示已安排的近期活动。

forms.label: 肯定句
forms.example: He is preparing dinner now.

forms.label: 否定句
forms.example: He is not preparing dinner now.

forms.label: 疑问句
forms.example: Is he preparing dinner now?

usages.label: 说话此刻正在发生
usages.example: Please be quiet. The baby is sleeping.
usages.translation: 请安静，宝宝正在睡觉。

usages.label: 现阶段的临时活动
usages.example: I am reading a long novel this month.
usages.translation: 我这个月正在读一本长篇小说。

usages.label: 已安排的近期活动
usages.example: We are meeting our coach on Friday.
usages.translation: 我们周五要见教练。

lessons.judgement: 重点识别正在进行的活动、现阶段的暂时情况，以及已安排的近期计划。
lessons.clues: now, at the moment, Look!, Listen! 通常提示现在进行，但不是排他条件。
pitfalls: 进行时 vs 一般现在：I am staying with my aunt this week（暂住）/ I stay with my aunt every summer（惯常）。
动词 -ing 拼写：make→making；run→running；lie→lying。
状态动词：I believe you. 一般不说 I am believing you。

lessons.title: 过去进行时
lessons.summary: 表示过去某一时刻或某段时间正在进行的动作。

forms.label: 肯定句
forms.example: She was watching a documentary at 8 p.m.

forms.label: 否定句
forms.example: She was not watching a documentary at 8 p.m.

forms.label: 疑问句
forms.example: Was she watching a documentary at 8 p.m.?

usages.label: 过去某时正发生
usages.example: At nine last night, I was doing my homework.
usages.translation: 昨晚九点我正在写作业。

usages.label: 一个动作打断另一动作
usages.example: I was reading when the lights went out.
usages.translation: 我正在阅读时，灯突然灭了。

usages.label: 过去两个动作同时进行
usages.example: While Mum was cooking, Dad was setting the table.
usages.translation: 妈妈做饭时，爸爸在摆餐具。

lessons.judgement: 以过去某一时刻为参照，说明当时正在进行的动作；突发事件常用一般过去时。
lessons.clues: at that time, at 8 last night, while, when；注意 when 与 while 不机械绑定某一种时态。
pitfalls: 过去进行 + 一般过去：We were having dinner when he arrived.（晚饭在进行；到达是较短事件）
while 不等于必用进行：While she lived in Paris, she studied French. 两个动词都可以用一般过去时。
was/were 主谓一致：They were watching，而不是 They was watching。

lessons.title: 现在完成时
lessons.summary: 表示过去发生的动作与现在的联系，或从过去持续到现在的状态。

forms.label: 肯定句
forms.example: He has finished his homework.

forms.label: 否定句
forms.example: He has not finished his homework.

forms.label: 疑问句
forms.example: Has he finished his homework?

usages.label: 过去发生、现在有结果
usages.example: I have lost my keys, so I cannot open the door.
usages.translation: 我把钥匙弄丢了，所以现在开不了门。

usages.label: 截至现在的经历
usages.example: She has visited Xi’an twice.
usages.translation: 她去过西安两次。

usages.label: 从过去延续到现在
usages.example: We have lived here since 2021.
usages.translation: 我们自2021年起一直住在这里。

usages.label: 首次经历
usages.example: This is the first time I have given a speech in English.
usages.translation: 这是我第一次用英语演讲。

lessons.judgement: 重点判断过去事件与现在的联系，包括当前结果、截至现在的经历和延续至今的状态。
lessons.clues: already, yet, ever, never, since, for, so far, recently；与明确且已结束的过去时间（如 yesterday）通常不用现在完成时。
pitfalls: gone 与 been：She has gone to the library.（现在可能仍在那里）/ She has been to the library.（去过）
短暂动词与时长：He has left for two hours. ×；He has been away for two hours. ✓
since / for：since + 起点（since 2021）；for + 时长（for three years）。
现在完成 vs 一般过去：I have seen the film.（经历/结果）/ I saw it last Friday.（具体过去时间）

lessons.title: 过去将来时
lessons.summary: 以过去某一时间为参照，表示在该时间之后将来发生的动作。
lessons.structure: would + 动词原形；was / were going to + 动词原形

forms.label: 肯定句
forms.example: He said he would help us.

forms.label: 否定句
forms.example: He said he would not help us.

forms.label: 疑问句
forms.example: Did he say he would help us?（通常出现在包含过去叙述的复合句中）

usages.label: 过去所作预测或陈述
usages.example: She said she would call me the next day.
usages.translation: 她说第二天会给我打电话。

usages.label: 过去已有打算
usages.example: We were going to leave, but it began to rain.
usages.translation: 我们原本打算离开，但开始下雨了。

usages.label: 过去视角下的未来
usages.example: At 15, he never imagined he would become a scientist.
usages.translation: 15岁时，他从未想到自己日后会成为科学家。

lessons.judgement: 以过去某个叙述时刻为参照，表达相对该时刻尚未发生的后续事件。
lessons.clues: the next day, the following week, later 等可能出现；不是看到 would 就断定是过去将来时，would 也可表达礼貌、习惯和假设。
pitfalls: 叙述视角：She says she will come.（现在说）/ She said she would come.（过去说）
would 不是万能过去将来：Would you help me? 是礼貌请求，不是单纯过去将来。
原计划未实现：I was going to call you, but I forgot.（原计划存在，后来没打）

lessons.title: 将来进行时
lessons.summary: 表示在将来某一指定时刻正在进行的动作。

forms.label: 肯定句
forms.example: She will be working at 3 p.m. tomorrow.

forms.label: 否定句
forms.example: She will not be working at 3 p.m. tomorrow.

forms.label: 疑问句
forms.example: Will she be working at 3 p.m. tomorrow?

usages.label: 将来某时正在进行
usages.example: At 8 tomorrow evening, I will be studying.
usages.translation: 明晚八点我会正在学习。

usages.label: 将来某段时期的持续安排
usages.example: This time next week, we will be travelling by train.
usages.translation: 下周这个时候我们将正在乘火车旅行。

usages.label: 礼貌询问对方安排
usages.example: Will you be using the computer this afternoon?
usages.translation: 今天下午你会用这台电脑吗？

lessons.judgement: 将来的指定时刻若有动作正在进行，可使用将来进行时。
lessons.clues: at this time tomorrow, at 9 tomorrow, this time next week；仅有 tomorrow 不一定用将来进行。
pitfalls: will do vs will be doing：I will finish it tomorrow.（将完成）/ I will be working on it at 3 tomorrow.（那个时刻在进行）
时间状语从句：While you are studying tonight, I will be preparing dinner.（状语从句按规则用现在时表达将来）
状态动词：I will know by tomorrow. 通常不用 I will be knowing。

lessons.title: 过去完成时
lessons.summary: 表示在过去某一参照时间之前已经发生或完成的动作。

forms.label: 肯定句
forms.example: The bus had left before we reached the stop.

forms.label: 否定句
forms.example: The bus had not left when we reached the stop.

forms.label: 疑问句
forms.example: Had the bus left when you reached the stop?

usages.label: 在过去某事之前已完成
usages.example: When I arrived, the film had already started.
usages.translation: 我到达时电影已经开始。

usages.label: 在过去某时之前完成
usages.example: By 9 last night, she had finished the report.
usages.translation: 昨晚9点前她已完成报告。

usages.label: 解释过去结果的原因
usages.example: He was tired because he had worked all day.
usages.translation: 他很累，因为此前工作了一整天。

lessons.judgement: 确定两个过去事件的先后关系；需要突出较早事件时，可使用过去完成时。
lessons.clues: by + 过去时间点, before, when, already；先后关系可以明确时，并非所有早发生的动作都必须用过去完成时。
pitfalls: 过去完成 vs 一般过去：When I got there, she had left.（离开先于到达）/ She left when I got there.（我到时她离开）
没有过去参照点不乱用：I had finished my work yesterday. 若没有另一个过去参照点，一般用 I finished my work yesterday。
had + V3：had went × → had gone ✓。

lessons.title: 现在完成进行时
lessons.summary: 表示从过去开始持续至今（或刚结束）的活动，侧重过程或持续性。

forms.label: 肯定句
forms.example: They have been waiting for an hour.

forms.label: 否定句
forms.example: They have not been waiting for an hour.

forms.label: 疑问句
forms.example: Have they been waiting for an hour?

usages.label: 持续到现在的活动
usages.example: I have been learning Spanish for six months.
usages.translation: 我学西班牙语已经六个月了。

usages.label: 刚结束而留下痕迹
usages.example: You look tired. Have you been running?
usages.translation: 你看起来很累，刚才一直在跑步吗？

usages.label: 反复进行的近期活动
usages.example: It has been raining a lot this week.
usages.translation: 这周一直频繁下雨。

lessons.judgement: 对比完成结果与活动过程：强调持续性或刚结束活动的当前影响时，可使用现在完成进行时。
lessons.clues: for, since, all morning, lately, recently；部分动词两种完成结构都可用，但侧重点有差异。
pitfalls: 完成 vs 完成进行：I have painted the wall.（强调画完）/ I have been painting the wall.（强调过程，是否完成未说明）
状态动词限制：I have known her for years. 通常不用 I have been knowing her。
持续到现在 vs 刚停止：I have been cleaning. 可以表示一直在打扫，也可以表示刚打扫完、手上还沾着灰。

questions.label: 填空
questions.prompt: My brother usually ____ (ride) his bike to school.
questions.explanation: usually 表习惯；主语第三人称单数。

questions.label: 填空
questions.prompt: The sun ____ (rise) in the east.
questions.explanation: 客观事实；the sun 为单数主语。

questions.label: 填空
questions.prompt: She ____ (not like) spicy food.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时否定；does 后动词原形。

questions.label: 填空
questions.prompt: The museum ____ (open) at 9 a.m. every day.

questions.label: 二选一
questions.prompt: Although he is listening to music now, he usually ____ chess after school.
questions.explanation: usually 表习惯；now 描述另一动作，不直接决定本空。

questions.label: 二选一
questions.prompt: She ____ the answer.
questions.explanation: know 通常是状态动词，不用于进行时表示“知道”。

questions.label: 改错
questions.prompt: He go to the library on Fridays.
questions.answer: He goes to the library on Fridays.

questions.label: 翻译
questions.prompt: 她每天晚上都读英语。
questions.explanation: every evening 表示规律，主语 she 用 reads。

questions.label: 语境填空
questions.prompt: The school library ____ (close) at 5:30 p.m. on weekdays.
questions.explanation: 固定开放时间；主语the school library为单数。

questions.label: 对话填空
questions.prompt: A: Where ____ your sister ____ (study)?  B: At a middle school near our home.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时询问通常情况；does后使用原形。

questions.label: 语境辨析
questions.prompt: My parents ____ in a hospital. They have worked there for years. [长期职业]
questions.explanation: 表达长期职业或工作地点，使用一般现在时。

questions.label: 语境辨析
questions.prompt: These days Leo ____ for a debate competition. [强调近期暂时性活动]
questions.explanation: these days表示现阶段；题目强调临时正在开展的准备工作。

questions.label: 否定句
questions.prompt: The girl ____ (not need) help with this question.
questions.explanation: need表示当前需要；第三人称单数否定用does not + V1。

questions.label: 改错
questions.prompt: Lily does not likes coffee.

questions.label: 句型转换
questions.prompt: Tom takes the bus to school every day. [改为一般疑问句]
questions.answer: Does Tom take the bus to school every day?
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句以does开头；takes还原为take。

questions.label: 汉译英
questions.prompt: 地球绕太阳转。
questions.answer: The Earth goes around the Sun.
questions.explanation: 表达客观事实；主语The Earth是单数，用goes。

questions.label: 填空
questions.prompt: We ____ (visit) the science museum yesterday.
questions.explanation: yesterday 指向已结束的过去。

questions.label: 填空
questions.prompt: She ____ (buy) a notebook last night.

questions.label: 填空
questions.prompt: They ____ (not go) to the cinema last Sunday.

questions.label: 填空
questions.prompt: ____ (be) you at home at 8 p.m. yesterday?
questions.explanation: you 的过去式 be 用 were。

questions.label: 二选一
questions.prompt: I ____ her at the school gate yesterday.

questions.label: 二选一
questions.prompt: He ____ an email two hours ago.

questions.label: 改错
questions.prompt: Did you finished your homework yesterday?
questions.answer: Did you finish your homework yesterday?

questions.label: 翻译
questions.prompt: 我们上周参加了一场比赛。
questions.answer: We took part in a competition last week.

questions.label: 语境填空
questions.prompt: Last night, we ____ (see) a bright star above the school.
questions.explanation: last night指已结束的过去时间；see的过去式为saw。

questions.label: 对话填空
questions.prompt: A: ____ your classmates at the meeting yesterday?  B: Yes, they were.
questions.explanation: be动词一般过去时疑问句；复数主语用were。

questions.label: 语境辨析
questions.prompt: I ____ this notebook two days ago.
questions.explanation: two days ago标明具体过去时间。

questions.label: 语境填空
questions.prompt: He ____ (not take) the train to Hangzhou last Friday.
questions.explanation: 过去时否定用did not + V1。

questions.label: 疑问句
questions.prompt: ____ you ____ (finish) the art project yesterday?
questions.explanation: 过去时间疑问句用Did + 主语 + V1。

questions.label: 改错
questions.prompt: Did your brother went to the concert last night?
questions.answer: Did your brother go to the concert last night?

questions.label: 句型转换
questions.prompt: They visited the museum last Sunday. [改为否定句]
questions.answer: They did not visit the museum last Sunday.
questions.explanation: 一般过去时的实义动词否定用did not + 原形。

questions.label: 汉译英
questions.prompt: 昨天放学后，我们在操场上打了篮球。
questions.answer: We played basketball on the playground after school yesterday.

questions.label: 填空
questions.prompt: I promise I ____ (help) you with the project.

questions.label: 填空
questions.prompt: Look at the dark clouds! It ____ (rain). [使用 be going to]

questions.label: 填空
questions.prompt: We ____ (not leave) before the meeting ends. [使用 will]
questions.explanation: 主句表达将来的打算或决定。

questions.label: 填空
questions.prompt: When she ____ (arrive) tomorrow, we will start.
questions.explanation: 时间状语从句中用一般现在时表达将来。

questions.label: 填空
questions.prompt: The doorbell is ringing. I ____ (open) the door. [使用will表达此刻作出的决定]
questions.explanation: 题目要求使用will，表示说话时作出的决定。一般语言使用中，will与be going to有时可以互换。

questions.label: 二选一
questions.prompt: He will ____ 16 next year.
questions.explanation: will 后用动词原形 be。

questions.label: 改错
questions.prompt: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay home.
questions.answer: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
questions.explanation: 条件状语从句用一般现在时。

questions.label: 翻译
questions.prompt: 我打算这个周末整理书桌。
questions.answer: I am going to tidy my desk this weekend.
questions.explanation: 有计划地做某事，可用 be going to。

questions.label: 语境填空
questions.prompt: We have booked the tickets. We ____ (visit) Nanjing this Saturday. [使用be going to]
questions.explanation: 已有安排；主语we用are going to + V1。

questions.label: 对话填空
questions.prompt: A: The phone is ringing.  B: I ____ (answer) it. [说话时作出决定]
